description: Interaction map: groups of actions that share mutable state, creating potential test scenarios where action order matters.

clusters.name: Form submission pipeline
clusters.testImplication: Every field-level action feeds into the submit payload. Test submit after each field combination to verify the full pipeline.

clusters.name: Create Unit dialog lifecycle

interactions.risk: Dialog open then cancel must fully reset all unit dialog state
Overlay dismiss must also reset state — same as cancel
Invalid size should prevent creation but button disable logic uses regex, not Zod
Creating a unit auto-selects it. User then picks a different unit — form.unitDefinitionId must update correctly
Created unit must be in localUnits AND selected in form before submit

clusters.testImplication: Unit dialog has its own mini form with open/close/reset lifecycle. Test create-then-submit, cancel-then-reopen, overlay-dismiss sequences.

clusters.name: Category combobox with create-on-type

interactions.risk: Typing a novel value shows '+ Create' option. Selecting it should set form.category to the trimmed input value.
After clearing, form.category must be null (not empty string) for nullableString transform to work correctly.
Filtering then selecting must set form.category to the selected value, not the search text.

clusters.testImplication: Category has create-on-the-fly via combobox. Test novel input, existing selection, clear, and verify submit payload in each case.

clusters.name: BOM mode toggle and field visibility

interactions.risk: After switching, only percentage field is shown. Previously entered quantity values remain in form state but are not visible.
After switching, only quantity field is shown. Previously entered percentage values remain in form state but are not visible.
CRITICAL: Quantities entered in quantity mode persist in form data after switching to percentage mode. Submit payload includes stale quantity values alongside new percentage values.
CRITICAL: Percentages entered in percentage mode persist in form data after switching to quantity mode. Submit payload includes stale percentage values alongside new quantity values.

clusters.testImplication: Mode switching does NOT clear the other field's values. Verify submit payloads after mode switches to confirm stale data behavior. The bomRefine only checks the active field — stale values pass through unchecked.

clusters.name: BOM row add/remove/select lifecycle

interactions.risk: Adding then immediately removing should leave form.bom unchanged. Removing from the middle must not corrupt other rows' indices.
Selecting the same component in two different rows triggers duplicate validation (bomRefine). Must show error on submit.
Removing a row recalculates percentage total. Total display must update immediately.
Adding an empty row then submitting must trigger validation errors (component required, quantity/percentage required).

clusters.testImplication: BOM rows use useFieldArray. Test add/remove sequences, duplicate component selection, and empty row submission.

clusters.name: Stock field in edit mode (delta computation)

interactions.risk: In edit mode, API computes delta = new - old. Reducing stock below 0 triggers 'insufficient stock' error from fifoDeduct. Increasing stock creates a new lot.

clusters.testImplication: Stock update in edit mode is a delta operation, not an absolute set. Test increase, decrease, decrease-below-zero, and no-change scenarios.

clusters.name: Unit field availability by mode

interactions.risk: Unit is required in create mode. In edit mode it is read-only and omitted from the update schema entirely.

clusters.testImplication: Unit dropdown only appears in create mode. Edit mode shows unit as read-only text. Verify unitDefinitionId is NOT in the update payload.

clusters.name: onBlur validation triggers

interactions.risk: Blur validation shows error immediately. Submit validates all fields. Both must show consistent error messages.

clusters.testImplication: Form uses onBlur mode. Field errors appear on blur, not on change. Test that errors appear after blur and clear after correction.

crossClusterInteractions.description: Creating a unit in the dialog must result in the new unit being selected AND included in the final submit payload.
crossClusterInteractions.risk: If localUnits updates but form.unitDefinitionId does not, submit will fail with 'Unit is required'.

crossClusterInteractions.description: Submit payload after a mode switch contains both quantity and percentage values for BOM rows. The API/DAL must handle stale values in the inactive field.
crossClusterInteractions.risk: CRITICAL: No client-side cleanup of stale BOM field values on mode switch. Stale data reaches the API.

crossClusterInteractions.description: A newly created category (via '+ Create') is just a string — no separate API call. It goes directly into the submit payload.
crossClusterInteractions.risk: Low risk, but verify the trimmed value matches what was typed.

crossClusterInteractions.description: Adding a row after switching modes creates a row with the new mode's field empty but the old mode's field also empty (fresh row).
crossClusterInteractions.risk: Low risk for new rows, but existing rows retain stale values from the previous mode.

crossClusterInteractions.description: Stock delta computation happens in the API handler, not the form. The form sends the absolute value; the API computes the difference.
crossClusterInteractions.risk: If the form sends a string that parseFloat cannot handle, the delta computation produces NaN.
